Only that Quarter of the Nakshtra in which there is the Vedha should be rejected while doing some auspicious deeds like marriage etc. But if the Vedha is by a Malefic Planet then the whole Nakshtra should be rejected as inauspicious for doing an auspicious deed. Acharya Varaha Mihira has said at one place:

The Samskaras of ‘Upanayana’ and ‘Mundana’ are not auspicious till 6 months after the marriage of some one in the family of 3 generations. And Mundana (in the family) is not auspicious till 6 months after ‘Upanayana’.

A daughter is not to be sent to her husband’s house till 6 months after the coming-in of a son’s wife. But if the year (Samvata) is changed then auspicious deeds may be done even within 6 months. Thus if the marriage of a son takes place in the month of Magha, then in the month of Vaisakha (within 6 months) the Samskaras like ‘Mundana’, ‘Upanayana’ etc may be done, as the Samvata (year) is changed (According to the Hindu System Samvata or year is changed in the Month of Chaitra which falls roughly in March or April).

The daughter and the son born in the Nakshtra of Ashlesha destroy (cause the death of) their mother-in-law; those born in that of Moola, their father-in-law; and the daughter born in the Nakshtra of Jyestha destroys the elder brother of her husband; and that born in the Nakshtra of Vishakha destroys the younger brother of her husband. The meaning is that they are inauspicious to the relatives stated above.

THE REMOVAL OF THE DEFECT ARISING DUE TO THE BIRTH IN THE NAKSHTRA OF ASHLESHA ETC.: The daughter born in the first three Charanas or quarters of Vishakha is the giver of happiness to the younger brother of her husband. The daughter (or the son also) born in the 4th Charana or quarter of Moola Nakshtra is auspicious for her father-in-law and that born in the first quarter of the Ashlesha Nakshtra is so for her mother-in-law.

THE EIGHT KOOTAS IN THE MELAPAKA OF MARRIAGE: 1. Varna, 2. Vashya, 3. Tara, 4. Yoni 5. Grahamaitri, 6. Ganamaitri, 7. Bhakoota, and 8. Nadi, these are the eight kinds of Kootas each of which has one more guna or point than the former one; that is, the guna or point of Varna is 1; that of Vashya, 2; that of Tara, 3; that of Yoni, 4; that of Grahamaitri, 5; that of Ganamaitri, 6; that of Bhakoota, 7 and that of Nadi, 8.

THE CONSIDERATION REGARDING THE KOOTA NAMED 'VARNA': The signs of Pisces, Scorpio and Cancer are Brahmins; Aries, Leo and Sagittarius are Kshtriyas; Taurus, Virgo and Capricorn are Vaishyas; and Gemini, Aquarius and Libra are Shudras (These–Brahmin, Kshtriya, Vaishya and Shudra–are the 4 Varnas or Castes). The girl belonging to higher Varna than the Varna of the boy is not auspicious, such has been said by the Pandits or the learned astrologers.

VASHYA KOOTA: Except the sign of Leo all the other signs are the Vashyas of the Male signs (Gemini, Virgo, Libra, and the latter half of Sagittarius), and all the watery signs (Cancer, Capricorn, Aquarius, Pisces) are the Bhakshyas (objects of eating) of the male signs. Leaving the sign of Scorpio all the other signs are the Vashyas of the sign of Leo. More Vashyas and Bhakshyas should be known by the behaviour of the people.

THE CONSIDERATION OF TARA KOOTA: Counting is to be done from the Nakshtra of the girl to that of the boy, and then it (Counting) is to be done from the Nakshtra of the boy to that of the girl. If by dividing each of them by 9, the remainder comes to be 3/5/7, then the Tara is inauspicious. And if the remainder is other than these (that is, if it is 1/2/4/6/8/0) then the Tara is auspicious.

YONI KOOTA: The yoni of the Nakshtras of Ashwini and Shatabhisha is 'Ashwa' (Horse); that of Swati and Hasta, Mahisha (She buffalo); that of Dhanishtha and Poorvabhadrapada, Singha (Lion); that of Bharani and Rewati, Haathi (Elephant); that of Pushya and Kritika, Medha (Mesha-Aja-Bakra or Ram in English); that of Shravana and Poorvashadha, Vanara (Monkey); that of Uttarashadha and Abhijita, Nakula (Mongoose); that of Mrigashira and Rohini, Sarpa (Serpent); that of Jyeshtha and Anuradha, Harina (deer); that of Moola and Ardra, Swana (dog); that of Punarvasu and Ashlesha, Marjara (Bidala or Tom cat in English); that of Magha and Poorvaphalguni, Mushaka (Rat); that of Vishakha and Chitra, Vyaghra (Leopard); and that of Uttaraphalguni and Uttarabhadrapada, Gau (Cow). There happens to be mutual Mahabair (Extreme enmity) between-two yonis of the Nakshtras stated in one quarter of the shloka, therefore these should be regarded as worthy of being left out while equating the gunas or marks.

Mars, Jupiter and the Moon are friends to the Sun, Venus and Saturn are enemy to him and Mercury is Neutral (neither friend nor enemy); Mercury and the Sun are friend to the Moon, there is no enemy of her and Mars, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn are neutral; the Moon Jupiter and the Sun are friends to Mars, Mercury is his enemy and Venus and Saturn are neutral to him; Venus and the Sun are friends to Mercury, the Moon is his enemy, and Jupiter, Saturn and Mars are neutral to him; the Sun, the Moon and Mars are friends to Jupiter, Mercury and Venus are his enemy and Saturn is neutral to him; Mercury and Saturn are friends to Venus, the Moon and the Sun are her enemy, and Mars and Jupiter are neutral to her; and Venus and Mercury are friends to Saturn, the Sun, the Moon and Mars are enemy to him and Jupiter is neutral to him.

GANA-KOOTA (The Koota of Ganas): The 9 (nine) Nakshtras namely Magha, Ashlesha, Dhanishtha, Jyeshtha, Moola Shatabhisha, Kritika, Chitra and Vishakha are Rakshasa (Demons) Ganas; the 9 other Nakshtras namely Poorvaphalguni, Poorvashadha, Poorvabhadrapada, Uttaraphalguni, Uttarashadha, Uttarabhadrapada, Rohini, Bharani and Ardra are Manushya (Man) Ganas; and the 9 still other Nakshtras namely Anuradha, Punarvasu, Mrigashira, Shravana, Rewati, Swati, Hasta, Ashwini and Pushya are Deva (gods) Ganas.

THE EFFECTS OF THE KOOTA OF GANAS: If the Gana of the bride and the bridegroom is the same, then there will be excessive love between wife and husband; love will be of average intensity if the gana of one is Devata (god) and of the other is Manushya (Man); there will be death if the Gana of one is Rakshasa (demon) and of the other is Manushya (Man); and there will be quarrel between them if the Gana of one is Devata (god) and of the other is Rakshasa (demon).

THE CONSIDERATION OF BHAKOOTA: If the Janama Rashi (the sign in which the Moon is situated at the time of birth) of the Bridegroom and of the bride are mutually in the 6th and the 8th House, it (this yoga or combination) is the giver of death; if it is in the 9th and in the 5th House, it will cause the loss of progeny; if it is in the 2nd and in the 12th House, it will cause poverty; and there will be happiness if they are in other places.

THE REMOVAL OF EVIL BHAKOOTA: If in the evil Bhakoota stated above (in the 31st Shloka) the Lord of the Janama Rashis of the bridegroom and the bride is the same, and the defect relating to Nadis is absent, then marriage is auspicious or if the Lords of the Janama Rashis have friendship with each other and the Nadi is also favourable, then also marriage is auspicious. If the Janama Rashis of the bridegroom and the bride are in the 6th and the 8th House from each other (if the Rashis of the bridegroom and the bride are in the 6th and in the 8th House from each other, it is called the 'Shadashtaka Dosha' or the defect of being the 6th and the 8th) and if there is the enmity of the Lords of the Rashis of both with each other but if there is the friendship of the Navamsha Lords of the Janama Rashis of both, and if both are endowed with strength also and are without Nadi Dosha (defect of the Nadis), the marriage is auspicious. If the Tara and the Nadi of the bridegroom and the bride are favourable, even then marriage is auspicious. If in the 'Dusta' or evil Bhakoota there is no friendship between the Lords of the Janama Rashis of the bridegroom and the bride, but if the Rashi of the Bride is the 'Vashya' of the Rashi of the Bridegroom and the Nadi is favourable, even then marriage is auspicious.

DUSTA BHAKOOTA NASHAKA YOGA (The combination which destroys the evil Bhakoota): If there is the friendship of the Lords of the Janama Rashis of the bridegroom and the bride or if there is friendship between the Lords of the Navamshas of the Janama Rashis, then there does not occur the Dosha or defect of Dusta Gana (Manushya, Rakshasa and Devata).

'Shubha' or auspicious 'Bhakoota' (the 3rd, the 11th, the 4th, the 10th the Bhakoota etc.) is the destroyer of the Doshas (defects) relating to the enmity of the Planets (the enmity of the Lords of the Rashis of the bridegroom and the bride).

Graha Maitri (the friendship of the Planetary Lords of the Janama Rashis of the bridegroom and the bride) destroys the Dosha (defect) of Dusta Bhakoota (evil Bhakoota).

NADI KOOTA (The Koota of Nadi): The Nakshtras of Jyeshtha, Moola, Ardra, Punarvasu, Uttaraphalguni, Hasta, Shatabhisha, Poorvabhadrapada and Ashwini are counted among the Nadi named as 'Adi'; those of Pushya, Mrigashira, Chitra, Anuradha, Bharani, Dhanishtha, Poorvashadha, Poorvaphalguni and Uttarabhadrapada among the Nadi named as 'Madhya'; and those of Swati, Vishakha, Kritika, Rohini, Ashlesha, Magha, Uttarashadha, Shravana and Rewati among the Nadi named as 'Antya'. If the Nakshtras of the bridegroom and the bride are in the same Nadi, the marriage of such persons is inauspicious; if the Nakshtras of the bridegroom and the bride are in the 'Madhya' Nadi they are certainly giv- ers of death.

THE FIRST MIDDLE (SECOND) AND LAST PARTS OF THE NAKSHTRAS: 6 Nakshtras beginning with Rewati (Rewati, Ashwini, Bharani, Kritika, Rohini and Mrigashira) are the Nakshtras of the First Part; 12 Nakshtras beginning with Ardra (Ardra, Punarvasu, Pushya, Ashlesha, Magha, Poorvaphalguni, Uttaraphalguni, Hasta, Chitra, Swati, Vishakha and Anuradha) are of the Middle (sec- ond) Part; and 9 Nakshtras beginning with Jyeshtha (Jyeshtha, Moola, Poorvashadha, Uttarashadha, Shravana, Dhanishtha, Shatabhisha, Poorvabhadrapada and Uttarabhadrapada) are of the Last part.

If the Nakshtras of both the bridegroom and the bride happens to be in the First Part, then the husband is dear to the wife; if in the Middle Part then both have great love for each other; and if in the Last Part then the husband has great love for the wife.

VARGA KOOTA (THE KOOTA OF VARGAS): The Lord of the अ (Aa) Varga ( अ आ इ ई उ ऊ ए ऐ ओ औ - these are vowels in the Hindi Language) is Garuda (a bird, the conveyance of Lord Vishnu) that of क (Ka) Varga ( क ख ग घ ङ ) is Marjara or Tom Cat;; that of च (Cha) Varga ( च छ ज झ ञ ) is Singha or Lion; that of ट (Ta) Varga ( ट ठ ड ढ ण ) is Swana or Dog; that of त (ta) Varga ( त थ द ध न ) is Sarpa or Snake; that of प (Pa) Varga ( प फ ब म म ) is Mushaka or Mouse; that of य (ya) varga ( य र ल व ) is Mriga or deer; that of श (sha) Varga ( श ष स ह ) is Medha or Ram; and the Varga which is the 5th from a Varga is the enemy to the former and vice versa.

THE REMOVAL OF NADI DOSHA OR THE DEFECT OF NADI: If the Janama Rashis of the bridegroom and the bride are the same and the Nakshtras of them are different or if the Nakshtras are the same and the Rashis are different, then there is no defect of the 'Nadi' and of the 'Gana'. And if the Nakshtras are the same but the quarters of the Nakshtras are different, it is also regarded auspicious, that is, it does not have the 'Nadi Dosha' or the Defect of Nadi.

THE NAKSHTRA MELAPAKA OR THE EQUATING OF THE NAKSHTRAS IN REFERENCE TO EMPLOYMENT, DEBT–MARRIAGE, RESIDENCE IN A VILLAGE OR TOWN: In reference to employment, if the Nakshtras of the employer comes before that of the employee (in serial order) the service done by the employee to his employer is wasted. In reference to lending and borrowing, if the first Nakshtra is that of the borrower and the Nakshtra of the lender comes afterwards, then the money lent is destroyed, that is, the creditor does not get back the money. In reference to marriage, if the Nakshtra of the woman comes before that of the man, then the bridegroom is destroyed (or dies soon). And if the Nakshtra of the village or the town in which the native has to reside comes before the Nakshtra of the native, then the happiness of living in a village is destroyed.

THE RULE REGARDING HORA: There is the Hora of the Moon to the first 15° in the even signs and that of the Sun to the 30° after that. And contrary to it in the odd signs there is the Hora of the Sun to the first 15° and that of Moon to the 30° after that.

TRIMSHAMSHA AND DRESHKANA OR DECANATE: In the even signs the first 5° are the Trimshamshas of Venus, after 7° of Mercury, 8° of Jupiter, 5° of Mars. In the odd signs there is the reverse of it, that is, the first 5° are the Trimshamshas of Mars, after that 5° of Saturn, 5° of Jupiter, 7° of Mercury and 5° of Venus. The Dreshkana or Decanate is of the same Rashi or sign upto 10°, of the 5th Rashi or sign from that upto 20°, and of the 9th Rashi or sign from that from 20° to 30°.

DWADSHAMSHAS AND THE EFFECTS OF SHADAVARGAS: The Dwadshamshas are in the order of the same Rashi or sign in which the Dwadshamsha is to be known, that is, there are 12 Dwadshamshas in any Rashi or sign beginning from that very Rashi or sign. In this way 6 Vargas (Divisions) - Lagna or Ascendant, Hora, Dreshkana or Decanate, Navamsha, Dwadshamsha and Trimshamsha - have been spoken of. The Vargas (Divisions) of the Benefic Planets give auspicious effects and those of the Malefic Planets give in-auspicious effects.

The time of the last two ghatis (48 minutes) of the Nakshtras of Jyeshtha, Rewati and Ashlesha and of the first two ghatis of those of Moola, Ashwini and Magha is referred to as 'Nakshtras Gandanta'. The time of the last ½ ghati (12 minutes) of the Ascendants of Cancer, Scorpio and Pisces, and of the first ½ Ghati of those of Leo, Sagittarius, and Aries, is referred to as the Lagna or Ascendant 'Gandanta'. The time of the last one Ghati of the Poorna Tithis (5,10,15 Tithis) and of the first one Ghati of the Nanda Tithis (1,6,11 Tithis) is referred to as the Tithi Gandanta. All these 3 Gandantas are inauspicious, that is, all these, there times or periods should be rejected while doing some auspicious deeds.

KARTARI YOGA (The Combination of Kartari): If a Malefic Planet, being Direct, is posited in the 12th House from the Ascendant at Marriage, and being Retrograde, is posited in the 2nd place from this Ascendant, then there occurs the yoga or combination named as 'Kartari'. This Kartari Yoga is the giver to the native of death, penury and grief.

Notes: There is the Kartari Dosha (or the Defect named as 'Kartari') if a Malefic Planet, being Retrograde is situated in the 12th House from the Ascendant at Marriage and if, being Direct, he is situated in the 2nd House.

In the Ascendant at marriage the, Moon should also be free from the 'Kartari Dosha' because there always remains the fear of evil and trouble if there is the Kartari Dosha in 'Chandra Lagna' or the Moon as Ascendant.

'Kartari Dosha' is merely a representative one in reference to the Ascendant. Actually all the Houses are subjected to the evil effect of this Dosha. Therefore, the 5th, the 7th and the 9th Houses from the Ascendant at marriage should also be free from the 'Kartari Dosha'. The Hindi word ‘Kartari’ means scissors. As cloth etc. between the two blades of a pair of Scissors is cut, in the same way, Ascendant which represents the body is destroyed between the two Malefic Planets situated in the 2nd and the 12th House. It happens in this way. The Retrograde Planet situated in the 2nd House comes back and reaches the Lagna or the Ascendant and the Direct Planet situated in the 12th House goes ahead and reaches the Ascendant. The conjunction of these two Malefic Planets is on the Ascendant and it is capable of destroying the body. It is because of this that the Acharyas, or the Astrologers have called it ‘Kartari Dosha’. Some Acharyas think that there is the characteristic of the ‘Kartari Dosha’ also when there is the situation of a Direct Malefic Planet in the 12th House and of Rahu or Ketu in the 2nd House.

If in the Ascendant at Marriage the Moon is in conjunction with the Sun, then there will be penury; if she is in conjunction with Mars, death; it will be auspicious if with Mercury; there will be happiness if she is with Jupiter; enmity if with Venus; and Vairagya or renunciation of the worldly matters if with Saturn; and if she is in conjunction with two Malefic Planets, she is the giver of death.

HOUSE FROM THE JANAMA LAGNA AND JANAMA RASHI IN THE LAGNA OR ASCENDANT AT MARRIAGE: If the 8th Rashi or sign from the Natal Ascendant and Janama Rashi is there in the Ascendant at Marriage, then such marriage is not auspicious. But when the Planetary lord of the Natal Ascendant or of the Janama Rashi is the Lord of the Ascendant at marriage also or if there is friendship between the two, then this Dosha or Defect does not apply.

THE REMOVAL OF THE DOSHA OR DEFECT OF THE RASHI OR SIGN OF THE 8TH HOUSE FROM THE JANAMA LAGNA OR THE JANAMA RASHI BEING THE ASCENDANT AT MARRIAGE: If the 8th sign from the Janama Lagna (Natal Ascendant) or the Janama Rashi is Pisces, Taurus, Cancer, Scorpio, Capricorn, or Virgo and the Ascendant at marriage is one of these signs, then this Dosha or Defect does not apply, because there being the friendship of the Lord of the Janama Lagna or of the Janama Rashi with the Lords of these Ascendants, such Ascendant is the giver of son, longevity, house and happiness.

THE CONSIDERATION WITH REGARD TO THE 8TH AND THE 12TH HOUSE AT THE TIME OF BIRTH IN THE ASCENDANT AT MARRIAGE: If the Navamsha Rashi or sign of the 8th House or the Lord of the sign of the 8th House from the Janama Lagna (Natal Ascendant) happens to be there in the Ascendant at marriage, then the celebration of marriage in such Ascendant is not auspicious or if the Navamsha of the 12th sign or the sign of the 12th House or the Lord of the 12th House happens to be there in the Lagna or Ascendant at marriage, then this yoga or combination proves to be a quarrel-causing one for the bridegroom and the bride.

THE VISHA GHATIS OF THE NAKSHTRAS, THE GHATI WHICH SHOULD BE REJECTED WHILE DOING SOME AUSPICIOUS DEEDS: The 4 ‘Ghatis’ after the 30 Ghatis of the Nakshtras of Rewati, Punarvasu, Kritika and Magha; after the 40 Ghatis of Rohini, after the 32 Ghatis of Ashlesha; after the 50 Ghatis of Ashwini, after the 18 Ghatis of Uttaraphalguni and Shatabhisha, af-ter the 20 Ghatis of the Nakshtras of Poorvaphalguni, Chitra, Uttarashadha and Pushya; after the 14 Ghatis of those of Vishakha, Swati, Mrigashira and Jyeshtha, after the 21 Ghatis of those of Ardra, and Hasta, after the 16 Ghatis of Poorvashadha, after the 24 Ghatis of the Nakshtras of Uttarabhadrapada, Poorvashadha and Bharani, after the 10 Ghatis of those of Anuradha, Dhanishtha and Shravana, after the 56 Ghatis of the Moola Nakshtra, the 4 Ghatis in each case as per the 'Madhyama Maana' (Average value which is 60 ghatis) are Visha Ghatis. These are to be rejected (as inauspicious) while doing some auspicious deed. And the Dhruwa or the constant of the Nakshtras should be multiplied by the Bhabhoga (the full Maana or value of the Nakshtra) and the resultant is to be divided by 60. the quotient thus arrived at is the spashta (Real) Dhruwa or constant. And the 4 visha Ghatis is also multiplied by the Bhabhoga and the re-sultant is to be divided by 60. The Quotient thus arrived at is the spashta (Peal) Visha Ghati.

THE NAMES OF THE 15 MUHURTAS OF DAY: Girisha (1), Bhujaga (2), Surya (3), Pitri (4), Vasu (5), Jala (6), Vishwa Deva(7), Abhijit (8), Vidhata (9), Indra (10), Indragni (11), Niririti (12), Udaka Nath (13), Aryama (14) and Bhaga (15)—these 15 are the Muhurtas in a day.

THE 15 MUHURTAS OF NIGHT: Shiva (1), Ajapada (2), Ahirbudhanya (3), Poosha (4), Ashwini Kumar (5), Yama (6), Agni (7), Brahma (8), Chandra (9), Aditi (10), Brahaspati (11), Vishnu (12), Surya (13), Twashtra (14) and Maruta (15)—these 15 are the Muhurtas of Night.

THE MUHURTAS IN WHICH AN AUSPICIOUS DEED SHOULD NOT BE DONE: Aryama (Uttaraphalguni) on Sunday, Brahma and Raksha (Rohini-Moola) on Monday Vahni and Pitri (Kritika and Magha) on Tuesday, Abhijita on Wednesday, Toya and Raksha (Poorvashadha-Moola) on Thursday, Brahma and Pitri (Rohini-Magha) on Friday and Isha and Sarpa (Ardra and Ashlesha) on Saturday-these Muhurtas should be rejected while doing some auspicious deed (that is, an auspicious deed should not be done in these Muhurtas).

THE NAKSHTRAS OF THE SAMSKARA OF MARRIAGE AND THE VALUE OF THE ABHIJITA NAKSHTRA: The celebration of the Samaskara of marriage is auspicious in the 'Vedha rahita' (without Vedha) Nakshtras of Mrigashira, Hasta, Moola, Anuradha, Magha, Rohini, Rewati, Uttaraphalguni, Uttarashadha, Uttarabhadrapada, Swati, on the other Tithis except the Rikta Tithis and the Amavasya Tithi and on auspicious days (Monday, Wednesday, Thursday and Friday).
The 4th Quarter of the Uttarashadha Nakshtra and the first 15th part of the Shravana Nakshtra added together is the value (period) of the Abhijita Nakshtra, that is, Abhijita is not a separate Nakshtra.

THE PANCH SHALAKA VEDHA IN MARRIAGE: The presence of a Planet in any one of the pairs of the Nakshtras of Rohini Abhijita, Bharani-Anuradha, Uttarashadha-Mrigashira, Shravana Magha, Hasta-Uttarabhadrapada, Swati-Shatabhisha, Moola-Punarvasu, Uttaraphalguni-Rewati causes the presence of ‘Vedha’, that is, if there is a planet in any one of a pair then the other member of the pair is called ‘Vidhdha’ (that is, the Nakshtra which has got ‘Vedha’). And the presence of a Planet in these pairs of Nakshtras causes mutual Vedha in the 4th-1st Quarters and the 3rd-2nd quarters, that is, there is the Vedha of the 4th Quarter with the 1st quarter and of the 3rd Quarter with the 2nd quarter.

The Nakshtras which is subjected to ‘Vedha’ by the Malefic Planets, the Nakshtra which has just been traversed by Malefic Planets, that is, the Nakshtra through which a Malefic Planet has just passed and the Nakshtra in the period of which all the three kinds of portents have occurred, if it (the Nakshtra) is traversed by the Moon, it becomes auspicious for doing auspicious deeds.

PAATA DOSHA OR DEFECT: The Nakshtra (at the time of marriage) which is there at the end of the yogas of Harshana, Vaidhriti, Sadhya, Vyatipaata, Ganda and Shoola, is affected by Paata Dosha or Defect.

If there is the Sun in one sign and the Moon in the other sign of the pairs of signs of Leo-Aries, Taurus-Capricorn, Libra-Aquarius, Virgo-Pisces, Cancer-Scorpio and Sagittarius-Gemini, there occurs the Dosha or Defect named as Kranti Samya (Maha Paata). It is not regarded as auspicious for doing auspicious deeds.

THE VIMSHOPAKA OF THE PLANETS IN THE ASCENDANTS: Merrcury and Venus both have 2 Vimshopakas each; the Moon has 5; the Sun 3.5; Jupiter, 3; and Saturn, Rahu, Ketu and Mars each of them has 1.5 Vimshopakas.

UPAGRAHA DOSHA (THE DOSHA OR DEFECT ARISING BECAUSE OF SUB PLANETS): If the Moon is situated in the Nakshtras numbered 5/8/10/14/7/19/15/18/21/22/23/24/25 from the Nakshtra in which the Sun is there, then there is the Dosha or Defect referred to as 'Upagraha Dosha' or Defect. The 'Upagraha Dosha' or Defect is not regarded as auspicious in the region around Delhi and in the Places called 'Vahlika' (West to Kashmir).

THE REMOVAL OF THE DOSHAS OF PAATA, UPAGRAHA AND LATTA AND THE DOSHA OF ARDHAYAMMA: The inauspicious quarter of a Nakshtra is only that one in which there is the situation of the Graha or planet which has caused the Dosha or Defect of Paata, Upagraha and Latta; that is, only that Quarter of a Nakshtra is to be rejected in which, in the Paata and upagraha Doshas, the Sun is situated; And in the Latta Dosha or Defect, there is the Dosha only in that Quarter of a Nakshtra in which the Planet which has caused the Dosha or Defect is situated. The number of the day, Sunday etc, is multiplied by 3 and the Product is divided by 8 and 1 is added to the remainder, and the number thus arrived at is 'Ardhayaama'

SPECIAL CONSIDERATION IN THE GANDHARVA MARRIAGE ETC.: In the Gandharva Marriage etc. the 4 Nakshtras from the Nakshtra of the Sun to that of the Moon are inauspicious, 2 (ahead of it) are auspicious, 3 are inauspicious, 1 is auspicious, 1 is inauspicious, 4 are inauspicious , 6 are inauspicious, 3 are auspicious, 1 is inauspicious and 3 are auspicious.

THE AUSPICIOUS TIME OF THE OTHER DEEDS RELATED TO THE MARRIAGE SAMSKAR: Before marriage the strength of the Moon of the bride and the bridegroom is to be seen or even in the absence of it in the Nakshtras described in marriage, there should be done for marriage preparing of pulses by getting them ground, separating husk from paddy (for preparing rice), grinding the wheat etc. decoration of the sacred Pitcher (called Mangal Kalasha in Sanskrit), decoration of the house and its parlour, making of Vedi and Mandap (Pavilian) etc. (Vedi is made for doing Havana or yajna for burning the Sacred fire and pouring butter, spices, myrrh etc. into it; Mandap is the pavilian under which Vedi is made). But the above stated deeds should not be started on the 3/6/9th day before marriage.

JAMITRA DOSHA: If in the 7th Sign from the Ascendant at marriage or from the Moon there is situated some Planet, it causes the Dosha or Defect named Jamitra'. The marriage Samskar is not auspicious in it, that is, the Ascendant and the Moon of the 7th sign from any planet is not auspicious. The Jamitra Dosha or Defect is also caused by the Planet who is situated in the 55th Navamsha from the Ascendant or the Moon. This brief Jamitra Dosha or Defect is also specifically inauspicious for marriage Samskar.

THE TIME OF ANOINTING (OILING) THE BRIDE ETC. BEFORE MARRIAGE: The number of days in which the would be bride born in the signs of Aries etc. and the child whose Upanayana Samskar may be done are to be bathed and anointed (oiled) etc. before these Samskars has been fixed. Thus the would be bride born in the sign of Aries is to be anointed etc. on 7 days before marriage; she who is born in that of Taurus, 10 days; in Gemini, 5 days; in Cancer, 10 days; in Leo, 5 days; in Virgo, 7 days; in Libra, 7 days

that is, the Jamitra Dosha caused by the Moon, Mercury, Jupiter and Venus is the giver of auspicious effects and that caused by the Sun, Mars, Saturn and Rahu is the giver of inauspicious effects. According to 'Muhurta Martanda'

that is, if there is any planet in the 7th sign from the Ascendant or the Moon, then that planet should be subtracted from the Longitude of the Ascendant or the Moon, and the sign etc. which are obtained thus should be converted into minutes and seconds. Then it is divided by 200, and if the Quotient comes to be 54. then there is no Jamitra Dosha or Defect. According to 'Martanda Vallabha' if the Sun occupies the 3/6/11 Houses the Jamitra Dosha or Defect does not come into being.

THE EFFECTS OF 'DASHA YOGA': If the remainder is 0 (zero) there will be fear of wind; if it is 1, fear of clouds; if 4, fear of fire; if 6, fear of the king; if 10, fear of thief; if 11, death; if 15, disease; if 18, fear of Vajra (a weapon); if 19, quarrel and; if 20, fear of the destruction of wealth. If after adding the numbers of the Nakshtras of the Sun and the Moon the figure happens to be an 'even' one, then it should be halved and 14 should be added to the figure thus arrived at. If after adding the figure happens to be an odd one then it should be halved after adding 1 (one) to it. After this 14 curved lines are to be drawn. Beginning with that Nakshtra which is obtained in this way write the names of all the Nakshtras including the Abhijita Nakshtra (that is all the 28 Nakshtras) at the ends of these lines. The planet which is there in a Nakshtra should also be written with that Nakshtra. If the planet and the Moon fall in the same line, then it should be thought that the Moon is subjected to 'Vedha' with that planet. This Vedha is inauspicious.

THE BAANA DOSHA OR DEFECT: To the number of the Tithis which have passed since the Pratipada (the 1st Tithi of a Hindi Month) of the Shukla Paksha (the bright half of the Month) is added the Ascendant at the marriage time and this is divided by 9. If the remainder is 8 then there is the 'Roga Baana' (Disease giving Baana); if it is 2, then Agni Baana (the Baana which causes the fear

This Dosha is popular in the region of Maharashtra, that is, it is in-auspicious in the Maharashtra, state or region of India.

The traversed degrees of the Sun on the related Tithi of the month in which the Dosha of Baana is to be considered are to be established in 5 places and to each of them is to be added respectively 6,3,1,8 and 4 and then each is to be divided by 9. And if the remainder is 5 after dividing the remainder of the total of all the places by 9, then there will be 'Sashalya Baana'.

THE REMOVAL OF BAANA IN THREE WAYS: According to the difference of time, the Chora Baana and Roga Baana are to be rejected in the night, the Agni Baana and Rajbaana in the day and the Mrityu Baana in the morning and the evening Sandhyas. According to the difference in days the Raj Baana is to be rejected on Saturday, Mrityu Baana on Wednesday, Agni Baana and Chora Baana on Tuesday, and Roga Baana on Sunday. According to the difference of the auspicious deeds to be done, the ‘Roga Baana’ should be rejected in doing ‘Yagyopaveeta Samskar’; Agnibaana in the covering (by thatches etc.) of the house; Raj Baana at the time when one starts to do a King's service (or Government Service); the Chora Baana in travelling; and the Mrityu Baana in Marriage Samskar.

THE ASPECTS OF THE PLANETS: The planets have their aspect with 1 (one) charana on the 3/10 Houses from the House in which they are situated, with 2 Charanas on the 9/5 Houses; with 3 Charanas on the 4/8 Houses; and with 4 Charanas (full aspect) on the 7th House. Another speciality about the aspects of the Planets is that Saturn has his (extra) aspect on the 3/10 Houses; Jupiter on the 9/5 Houses, and Mars on the 4/8 Houses and all the planets have their full aspect on the 7th House from the House in which they are posited.

THE CONSIDERATION OF NAVAMSHAS IN THE ASCENDANT AT THE MARRIAGE TIME: If the Lord of the Navamsha of the Ascendant at the time of marriage aspects the Navamsha sign or the Ascendant or he is posited in either of them, then it is very auspicious for the bridegroom.

And if the Lord of the 7th sign from the Navamsha which is there in the Ascendant aspects the 7th Navamsha, that is, his own Navamsha or he is posited in his own Navamsha, or the Lord of the 7th Navamsha from the Navamsha sign of the Ascendant aspects the 7th House from the Ascendant, then it is auspicious for the bride. If the above is reversed, then it is inauspicious for both.

Notes: Suppose the Ascendant at the marriage time is Libra which happens to be there in the Navamsha of Sagittarius. Then if the Lord of Sagittarius Jupiter is situated in Gemini, then he aspects the sign of Sagittarius, and this Jupiter aspects the sign of Libra as well. Therefore this situation will be auspicious for the bridegroom or if Jupiter is situated in Sagittarius or Libra, even then it will be auspicious for the bridegroom.

If Mercury, the Lord of the 7th sign (Gemini) from the Navamsha sign (Sagittarius) aspects the sign of Gemini or of Sagit- tarius or if he is situtaed in the sign of Sagittarius, then it is auspicious for the bride. If that very Mercury being situated in any House in the Ascendant aspects the 7th House, even then it is auspicious for the bride.

If the Lord of the Navamsha of the Ascendant at the marriage time aspects the Navamsha, and the Ascendant Lord aspects the Ascendant, then it is specially auspicious for the bridegroom. Or if the Navamsha Lord aspects the Ascendant and the Ascendant Lord aspects the Navamsha, even then the situation is indicative of auspiciousness. And if the Lord of the 7th sign from the Navamsha aspects the 7th sign from the Navamsha and the Lord of the 7th House from the Ascendant aspects the 7th House from the Ascendant, then it is auspicious for the bride. Or if the Lord of the 7th House from the Navamsha aspects the 7th sign from the Ascendant, and the Lord of the 7th sign from the Ascendant aspects the 7th sign from the Navamsha, then it is very auspicious for the bride.

If the friend of the planet who is the Lord of the Navamsha which is there in the Ascendant is a Benefic one and if he aspects the Navamsha sign or the Ascendant, then it is said in the Shastras (Books on Astrology) that the bridegroom who is going to be joined in wedlock will have excellent effects.

And if the friend of the Lord of the 7th Navamsha is a Benefic planet and if he aspects the 7th Navamsha or if he aspects the 7th sign from the Ascendant, then it causes good effects for the bride.

THE SANKRANTI GHATIS OF EVERY PLANET: 33 Ghatis in the Sankranti of the Sun, 2 Ghatis in that of the Moon, 9 Ghatis in that of Mars, 6 Ghatis in that of Mercury, 88 Ghatis in that of Jupiter, 9 ghatis in that of Venus and 160 Ghatis in that of Saturn should be rejected (as inauspicious for doing an auspicious deed). Of these the Sankranti of the Sun is more inauspicious than those of the other planets.

THE ASCENDANTS NAMED AS PANGU (LAME), ANDHA (BLIND) AND BADHIRA (DEAF): The Ascendants of Libra and Scorpio become Badhira (Deaf) in the day time and those of Capri-corn and Sagittarius in the night time. The Ascendants of Leo, Aries and Taurus become Andha (Blind) in the day time and those of Virgo, Gemini and Cancer in the night time. The Ascendant of Aquar-ius beocmes Pangu (Lame) in the day time and that of Pisces in the night time.

THE ASCENDANTS NAMED AS PANGU, ANDHA AND BADHIRA ACCORDING TO ANOTHER VIEW: The Ascendants of Sagittarius, Libra and Scorpio are named as deaf in the afternoon; those of Gemini, Cancer and Virgo are named as Andha (blind) in night; those of Leo, Taurus and Aries are Andha (blind) in day; and those of Capricorn, Aquarius and Pisces are Pangu (lame) in both the Sandhyas (of the morning and of the evening).

THE EFFECTS OF THE ASCENDANTS NAMED AS BADHIRA ETC: If a marriage takes place in the Badhira Ascendants, it causes poverty; if a marriage is done in day in the Andha Ascendant the bride is widowed; there occurs the death of the issues in case marriage is done in Night in the Ascendant named as 'Andha' and if a marriage takes place in the Ascendant named as Pangu there occurs the destruction of wealth. But if there is the aspect of Jupiter on the Ascendant or on the Ascendant Lord there occurs no Dosha or Defect.

Notes: The effects are obtained in that very period in which an Ascendant is called Andha, Pangu and Badhira. Thus, the Virgo Ascendant has been called Andha in night, so its effect will be obtained in night only.

THE EXCELLENT NAVAMSHAS OF THE MARRIAGE OF A DAUGHTER: If a marriage is done in the Navamsha of the Sagittarius, Libra, Virgo, Gemini or Pisces sign, then the girl married thus certainly remains faithful to her husband.

A daughter should not be married in the last Navamsha, but if the Navamsha of a sign is Vargottama and marriage is done in it, then it is excellent. But if the Moon is situated in the Libra or Capricorn sign, then marriage should not be done in the movable Navamsha of a Movable Ascendant, that is, even Vargottama is not auspicious in this situation.

Saturn in the 12th House from the Ascendant at marriage, Mars in the 10th House, Venus in the 3rd House, the Moon and a Malefic planet in the Ascendant are not auspicious. And the Ascendant Lord, Venus and the Moon, these in the 6th House; and the Moon, the Ascendant Lord, Benefic Planets and Mars in the 8th House and all the planets in the 7th House are not excellent or auspicious.

BENEFIC PLACES OF THE PLANETS IN THE ASCENDANTS AT MARRIAGE: The Sun, Ketu, Rahu and Saturn are auspicious or Benefic if they are situated in the 3/11/8/6 Houses from the Ascendant; Mars is auspicious in the 3/11/6 Houses; the Moon in 2/3/11 Houses; Mercury and Jupiter are auspicious in the Houses other than the 7/12/8 ones; and Venus is auspicious in the Houses other than the 8/3/7/6/12 ones.

THE EXCEPTION TO THE DOSHAS (DEFECTS) LIKE KARTARI ETC.: If the two Malefic Planets causing the Kartari Dosha (Defect) are in their enemies' signs or if they are in their debilitation signs or if they are combust, then the 'Kartari Dosha' or (defect) does not occur. And if Venus, being in her enemy's sign or being in her debilitation sign is situated in the 6th House, the Dosha (Defect) does not occur (Venus situated in the 6th House has been said to be inauspicious or Malefic); if Mars, being in the 8th House, is combust, is in his enemy's sign, or is in his debilitation sign (Mars has been regarded as a Dosha Karaka Planet or inauspicious planet in the 8th House) then the Dosha or Defect does not occur; and if the Moon; being in the 6/8/12 Houses, is in her debilitation sign or in her debilitation Navamsha, then she also does not cause Dosha or defect (the Moon has been said to be Malefic in the 6/8/12 Houses).

THE TIME OF GODHULI LAGNA (GODHULI OR EVENING ASCENDANT): In the Godhuli Lagna no special Dosha of Nakshtra, Tithi, Karana, Lagna, day, Navamsha, Muhurta, yoga, the Situation of planets in the 8th House and Jamitra etc. is to be considered. The Munis or the sages have praised the Godhuli Lagna and have recommended it as auspicious for doing all deeds (religious).

KINDS OF THE GODHULI LAGNA: If in the season of Hemanta (Margashirsha, Pausha, Magha and Phalguna) the Sun ap- pears to be a disc of red colour, it should be thought that it is the time of 'Godhuli Lagna'. And in the months of Chaitra, Baisakha, Jyeshtha and Asadha, it is the time of the 'Godhuli Lagna when half of the disc of the Sun is set; in those of Shravana, Bhadrapada, Ashwina, and Kartika it is when the disc of the Sun is completely set. These three kinds of the Godhuli Lagnas are regarded as auspicious for doing all kinds of auspicious deeds.

THE THINGS WHICH SHOULD BE LEFT EVEN IN THE GODHULI TIME: On Thursday the Godhuli Lagna is auspicious only after the setting of the Sun and on Saturday it is auspicious before the setting of the Sun. Even in the Godhuli Lagna, if the Moon is in the Ascendant or in the 6/8 Houses, it causes the death of the bride; and if Mars is in the Ascendant or in the 7/8 Houses from the Ascendant, it causes the death of the bridegroom. And if even in the Godhuli time the Moon is in the 11/2/3 Houses, there occurs the obtainment of happiness to the bridegroom and the bride.

Notes: On Thursday, before the setting of the Sun there occurs the Dosha of 'Ardhayaama'. It is because of this that the Godhuli Lagna after the setting of the Sun only has been said to be auspicious. But on Saturday it is the Godhuli Lagna before the setting of the Sun only that has been regarded as auspicious as on this day after the setting of the sun there occurs the Muhurta named 'Kulika' and the moments of the Kulika Muhurta are very inauspicious.

THE MOTION (SPEED) OF THE SUN IN THE SIGNS ARIES AND SO ON: In Aries the motion (speed) of the Sun is 58 Kalas, (minutes), in Taurus 57 Kalas, in Gemini 57 Kalas, in Cancer 57 Kalas in Leo 58 Kalas, in Virgo 59 Kalas, in Libra 60 Kalas, in Scorpio 61 Kalas, in Sagittarius 61 Kalas, in Capricorn 61 Kalas, in Aquarius 60 Kalas, and in Pisces 59 Kalas.

TO KNOW THE LONGITUDE OF THE SUN AT A GIVEN TIME: The ghatis and the Palas which have passed since the time when the Sankranti of the Sun started to occur to the Ishta Kaala of the Ascendant at Marriage or to the other desired Ishta Kaala, are to be multiplied by the above stated motion (speed) of the Sun. The product is to be divided by 60. The quotient in degrees etc. is to be added to the number of signs which have been traversed by the Sun and it will give the longitude of the Sun at a given time (Ishta Kaala).

TO KNOW THE DEGREES ETC OF THE DESIRED LAGNA: The Navamsha number before the auspicious Navamsha in the auspicious Ascendant for marriage etc. which is desired to be known should be multiplied by 10 and the product is to be divided by 3, and the quotient thus obtained are the traversed degrees etc. of the Ascendant for knowing the shadavarga.

THE KNOWLEDGE OF ISHTA KAALA FROM THE LONGITUDE OF THE ASCENDANT AND OF THE SUN: There will be separately the to be traversed Palas of the Sun and the traversed Palas of the Ascendant if the to be traversed degrees of the Sayana Sun and the traversed degrees of the Sayana Ascendant are multiplied separately by their 'Udayamaana' or Palas at the time of rising and each of them then is divided by 30. To the Sum of both (the obtained to be traversed palas of the Sayana Sun and the traversed palas of the Ascendant) are to be added the 'Udaya Palas' of the signs between the Sun and the Ascendant and this should be divided by 60, and the figure thus obtained is the Ishta Kaala or the desired time from the time of the Sunrise.

SPECIAL STATEMENT ON KNOWING THE ISHTA KAALA: If the Sayana Ascendant and the Sayana Sun are in the same sign, then the Sun is subtracted from the Ascendant and the remaining degrees etc. are multiplied by the Udayamaana of that sign and the product is divided by 30, then the quotient thus obtained is itself Ishta Kaala.

If the Sayana Ascendant is less than the Sayana Sun, then the Ishta Kaala obtained in this way will be of before the Sunrise. If the Ascendant is to be known in the night then 6 signs are added to the Sun, the Ascendant etc. are to be known by the method stated above.

AUSPICIOUS TIME FOR THE COMING IN OF THE NEWLY WEDDED BRIDE: The coming in of the bride (to her husband's home) after marriage is regarded as auspicious during the 15 days from the day on which the marriage is celebrated on the even days (2/4/6/8/10/12/14) and if the days are odd then on 5/9/7th day. If the coming in of the bride may not occur during the 16 days after the day of marriage, then it is regarded auspicious during one month on odd days (17/19/21/23/25/27/29th day); then after one month during one year in the odd months and then after one year in the odd years. If the time of the coming in of the bride to her husband's home exceeds five years, then the coming in may be at any time according to one's own will.

The first coming in of the bride to her husband's home is auspicious in the Nakshtras named as Dhruwa (Uttaraphalguni, Uttarashadha, Uttarabhadrapada and Rohini), those named as Kshipra (Hasta, Ashwini and Pushya), those named as Mridu (Mrigashira, Rewati, Chitra and Anuradha), Shravana, Dhanishtha, Moola, Magha and Swati, on the other Tithis and days except the Rikta Tithis (4/9/14) and Tuesday and Sunday.

If after the marriage the bride lives in her husband's home in the month of first Jyeshtha, she destroys the elder brother of her husband, if she lives there in the first Adhi massa, she destroys her husband, if in the first Ashadha she destroys her mother-in-law; if in the first Pausha, she destroys the father-in-law; and if in the first Kshaya Maasa she destroys her own self. And if after the marriage she lives in her father's house in the month of Chaitra she destroys her father.

THE MUHURTA FOR THE DWIRAGMANA (The bride's going to her husband's home for the second time after marriage): The Muhurta (auspicious time) for the bride's going to her husband's home for the second time after her first coming in there is, in odd years, when the Sun is in Aquarius, Aries, Scorpio,-when the Sun and Jupiter are in a benefic house from the sign of Virgo, on auspicious days, in the Ascendants of Gemini, Pisces, Virgo, Libra and Taurus, and in the Nakshtras named as Laghu (small) (Hasta, Ashwini and Pushya), those named as Dhruwa (Uttaraphalguni, Uttarashadha, Uttarabhadrapada, and Rohini), those named as Chara or Movable (Swati, Punarvasu, Shravana, Dhanishtha and Shatabhisha), those named as Mridu or Delicate (Mrigashira, Rewati, Chitra, Anuradha) and that of Moola-in these 17 Nakshtras.

THE CONSIDERATION OF VENUS ON THE BRIDE'S GOING TO HER HUSBAND'S HOME FOR THE SECOND TIME: If at the time of going on a journey Venus happens to be in front and on the right side, then the child on his first journey, and the pregnant woman and the newly wedded woman should not go on the journey, because the first journey of the child, and the journey of the pregnant woman and of the newly wedded woman cause respectively death of, abortion of and sterility in the person concerned.

Notes: Venus rises in the east or in the west. When the Spashta (Longitude) of Venus is more than the Spashta (Longitude) of the Sun, then she rises in the west. In this condition if the journey is done towards the west then Venus will be in front, and if it is done towards the south then she is on the right side. Therefore, leaving the West and the South the journey towards the East and the North may be undertaken. On the other hand if the Spashta of Venus is less than that of the Sun, then Venus rises in the morning in the east. In this condition she is in front in the journey towards the east and on the right side in that towards the north. Therefore, leaving the east and the north, journey towards the west and the south may be undertaken. It will be auspicious. The woman who is pregnant and also who has been newly delivered of a child should always have this consideration of Venus.

THE REMOVAL OF THE DOSHA OR DEFECT OF VENUS WHEN SHE IS IN FRONT: At the time of going from one city to another, on the coming of some emergency condition in the country, when going to join a marriage (in the marriage party), in the pilgrimage to some temple (or other holy place) in the condition when one is subjected to the oppression of the king and has to go to another place and the coming in for the first time of the newly wedded bride to her husband's home- in these conditions-Venus's being in front does not cause any Dosha or Defect.

If the rising or emerging, of the breasts of a married woman happens to be in her father's house and if she has menses there, then the Dosha or Defect of Venus's being in front is not there. And to the issues of the Gotra or family of Bhrigu, Angira, Vatsa, Vashishtha, Kashyap, Atri, Bharadwaj of these seven sages-there does not occur the Dosha or Defect of Venus's being in front.

THE DOING OF YAJNA OR THE WORSHIP OF FIRE THE MUHURTA (AUSPICIOUS TIME) FOR AGNYADHAAN OR WORSHIP OF FIRE: The doing of Agnihotra (Yajna) is auspicious at the time when the Sun is in Uttarayana (moving towards the North) on the other Tithis except those of Rikta (4/9/14) in the Nakshtras named as Mishra or mixed (Vishakha and Kritika), in those named as Dhruwa or Sthira (the 3 Uttaras and Rohini), in those of Rewati, Mrigashira, Jyeshtha, and Pushya-in these 10 Nakshtras. The doing of Yajna or Havana is inauspicious if the Moon, Mars, Jupiter and Venus are in their debilitation signs, are combust, are defeated in the Planetary war and are in the enemy signs.

LAGNA SHUDHDHI (OR AUSPICIOUS LAGNA) IN AGNYA DHAAN: The situation of the Moon and of the Navamshas of the Cancer, Capricorn, Pisces, Aquarius signs and of the Lagna or Ascendant of these is regarded as inauspicious in Agnyadhaan. If in the 9/5/1/4/7/10/3/6/11 Houses from the Lagna or Ascendant there are the Sun, the Moon, Jupiter and Mars and in the 6/3/11 Houses there are Mercury, Venus, Saturn, Rahu and Ketu, and the 8th House from the Lagna or Ascendant is without any Planet, then Agnyadhaan is auspicious.

THE YOGA OR COMBINATION DUE TO WHICH THE NATIVE CONTINUOUSLY DOES YAJNAS: If Jupiter is situated in the Ascendant of Sagittarius or there is the Aries sign in the Ascendant and Mars is situated in it or Mars is there in the 10th or the 7th House from the Ascendant or in the 3/6/11 Houses there is the Moon or the Sun, then the doer of Agnihotra does Yajnas for a long time.

THE MUHURTA FOR CORONATION: The auspicious Muhurta for the Coronation of a king is when the Sun is in Uttarayana (moving towards the North and is in the signs from Capricorn to Gemini), Jupiter, the Moon and Venus are not combust, Mars, the Sun, the Lord of the Natal Ascendant, the Lord of the present Dasha of the would-be-king and the Lord of the Janama Rashi or sign are endowed with strength.

Coronation should not be done in the Chaitra month, on the Rikta Tithis (4/9/14), in the night on Tuesday and in the Adhimaas.

THE NAKSHTRAS AND THE AUSPICIOUS LAGNAS OR ASCENDANTS FOR THE CORONATION: The Rajyabhisheka or Coronation of a King is auspicious in the Nakshtras of Jyeshtha, Sharvana, those named as Kshipra (Hasta, Ashwini and Pushya), those named as Mridu (Mrigashira, Rewati, Chitra and Anuradha), those named as Dhruwa or Sthira (the 3 Uttaras and Rohini), in the Ascendant rising with its head (Gemini, Leo, Virgo, Libra Scorpio and Aquarius) or the King's natal Ascendant and in the Ascendant of the 3/6/10/11 Houses from the Janama Rashi or sign, when the Malefic Planets are in the 3/6/11 Houses and when there are Benefic Planets in the Angles, the Trines and 11/2/3 Houses.

THE EFFECTS OF THE LAGNA OR ASCENDANT AND THE REMOVAL OF THE DOSHAS OR DEFECTS: If there are Malefic Planets in the Ascendant at the time of the Rajyabhisheka the king will be affected by diseases; if there is a malefic planet in the 8th House, then there will be the occurrence of death; if there is a Malefic Planet in the 5th House, then there will be trouble and pain to the King's son; if there are Malefic Planets in the 2nd and the 12th House the King will suffer from poverty; if there is a Malefic Planet in the 10th House, he will be subjected to indolence or laziness; if there are Malefic Planets in the 4th and the 7th Houses, the King will be without rights; and if there are Benefic Planets in the Angles then it is auspicious in every way.

THE YOGA OR COMBINATION OF IMMOVABLE PROPERTY ON THE BASIS OF THE RAJYABHISHEKA LAGNA: If Jupiter is in the Ascendant or in a Trine, Mars in the 6th House and Venus in the 10th House, then the king is endowed with Rajya Lakshmi (Royal wealth) and happiness. And if Saturn is in the 3rd, the Sun in the 11th, and Jupiter, in the 10th or in the 4th House, then the King's land (Kingdom) always remains immovable or fixed, that is, there always remains stability in the kingdom of the king.

To those Kings (persons) whose 'Janama Kundali' or horoscope is known according to their time of birth, the Muhurta (auspicious time) for journeys and travels should be told through the medium of their Janama Kundalis or horoscopes, and those who have no knowledge of the time of their birth should be instructed about the Muhurta of a journey according to the knowledge of the auspicious and the inauspicious situations of 'Shakun' or 'Omens' and of Horary System.

THE QUESTION INDICATING AUSPICIOUS EFFECTS IN A JOURNEY : If the Janama Rashi or the Janama Lagna is there in the Horary Ascendant or if the Lords of both these signs are in the Lagna or Ascendant or any Sign happening to be in the 3/6/10/11 Houses from the Janama Rashi, or the Janama Lagna is also there in the Horary Ascendant, then the journey of the king gives him victory.

AUSPICIOUS QUESTION FOR PERSONS WHOSE DATE OF BIRTH IS NOT KNOWN: If at the time of asking the question there is beautiful charming land around the astrologer or an auspicious thing is seen or something is heard about it and the person is putting the question to the astrologer with respect and reverence or if there is a ‘Chara’ or Movable Lagna or Ascendant (1/4/7/10) which is occupied by or aspected by Benefic Planets, even then Journey is the giver of auspicious effects.

5. THE QUESTION RELATING TO A JOURNEY INDICATING INAUSPICIOUS EFFECTS : If in the Lagna or Ascendant of the Horary Chart there are situated Mars and the Moon and Saturn aspects them, then the king is defeated by his enemy; or if the Moon is in the 7th or the 8th House from the Ascendant of the Horary Chart, and there is the Sun in the Ascendant, then failure is obtained in the journey. If the Sun is posited in the 8th or the 7th House and the Moon is gone in the Ascendant or if some Malefic Planet is situated in the 4/8/1/7 House from the Lagna or Ascendant of the Horary Chart, even then the person putting the question (the king) gets defeated.

6. THE CONSIDERATION OF THE DIRECTION OF THE JOURNEY ON THE BASIS OF THE QUESTION PUT BY THE PERSON UNDERTAKING THE JOURNEY : If from Mars there is in a Trine (5/9) Saturn, Venus, Mercury, Jupiter, one of these or all of them, or if from the Sun there is in Trine the Moon then the person undertaking the journey will not be able to go in the direction in which he wants to go. The journey will be in the direction of that Planet who is the stronger of the two.

7. THE SECOND YOGA OR COMBINATIONS REGARDING THE DIRECTION OF THE JOURNEY : The Journey is done in the direction of the Planet who is the strongest one among those Planets who are in the 5th House from the Lord of the Direction in the Lagna at the time of asking the question.

8. THE EFFECTS OF A JOURNEY ACCORDING TO THE SUN'S LONGITUDE : If at the time of the Journey the Sun is in the signs of Sagittarius, Aries, and Leo, the journey is auspicious or beneficial, if he (the Sun) is in those of Capricorn, Aquarius, Gemini, Virgo, Taurus and Libra, it (the journey) gives effects of medium level (that is, it is neither auspicious nor inauspicious), and if he is in those of Cancer, Pisces and Scorpio, then the journey undertaken in such times is a long one. The journey in the Taras of 1/5/7/3, at the time of the journey, from the Janama Rashi of the person going on a journey is harmful and causes evil, that is, in the Nakshtras 1/3/5/7/10/12/14/16/19/21/23/25 from the Janama Nakshtra, journey should not be undertaken.

13. THE GHATIS WHICH SHOULD BE REJECTED ACCORDING TO ANOTHER VIEW: In a journey for the fulfilment of one's desire of getting victory the first half of the Nakshtras of Kritika, Magha and Swati, and the 2nd half of the Nakshtras of Chitra, Ashlesha and Bharani should be rejected as inauspicious; and according to the view of Shukracharya, the Nakshtras of Swati and Magha should be completely rejected as inauspicious.

14. THE JEEVA, MRITA, KARTARI AND GRASTA NAMES OF THE NAKSHTRAS: Thirteen (13) Nakshtras traversed by Rahu are named as 'Jeeva paksha' and they are auspicious. Thirteen(13) Nakhstras which are to be traversed by Rahu are named as Mrita Paksha' and they are inauspicious. The Nakhstra in which Rahu is situated is named as 'Kartari' and the 15th Nakshtra from the Nakshtra named as 'Kartari' is named as Grasta.

15. THE EFFECTS OF THE NAKSHTRAS WHICH ARE NAMED AS JEEVA PAKSHA ETC.: If the Sun is in the Nakshtras named as 'Mrita Paksha' and the Moon is situated in those named as 'Jeeva Paksha' then the journey is auspicious. In the reverse condition there is loss in the journey. And if during the time of the journey both the Sun and the Moon are in the Nakshtras named as 'Jeeva Paksha' the journey is auspicious. The Nakshtras named as 'Grasta' are more auspicious in comparison to those named as 'Mrita Paksha' and those named as 'Kartari' are more auspicious than those which are named as 'Grasta'. And if the 'Chandra Yayi' (the king who goes out to conquer his enemy) and 'Surya Sthhayi' (the king who is sitting in his castle) both these are in 'Jeeva Paksha', then both the kings make a mutual treaty. If the Moon be in 'Jeeva Paksha', then the 'Yayi' gets victory; and if the Sun is there in 'Jeeva Paksha', then it is the 'Sthayi' who gets victory.
9. If the Sun be in ‘Jeeva Paksha’ and the Moon be in ‘Mrita Paksha’, then it is the ‘Sthayi’ or the Defendant who gets victory.

16, 17. NAKSHTRAS NAMED AS AKULA, KULA-KULA AND KULA: The Nakshtras of Swati, Bharani, Ashlesha, Dhanistha, Rewati, Hasta, Anuradha, Punarvasu, those named as Dhruwa (the 3 Uttaras and Rohini), the odd Tithis (1/3/5/7/9/11/13/15) and the days of Monday, Saturday and Thursday, each of these is named as 'Akula'; the Nakshtras of Moola, Shatabhisha, Ardra and Abhijita, the 2/6/10 Tithis and the day of Wednesday each of these is named as 'Kulakula'; and the Nakshtras of the 3 Poorvas, Ashwini, Pushya, Magha, Mrigashira, Shravana, Kritika, Vishakha, Jyeshtha and Chitra, the days of Friday and Tuesday and the 12/8/14/4 Tithis, each of these is named as 'Kula'. If the war is begun in the Nakshtra, the Tithi and the Day named as 'Akula' (or if the case is filed in these) then it is the Yayi (the plaintiff if it is a case in the Court) who gets victory; if it is begun in the Nakshtra, the Tithi and the Day named as 'Kula', then it is the 'Sthayi' (the Defendant in a case in the court) who gets victory; and if it is begun in the Nakshtra, the Tithi and the Day named as 'Kulakula', then both make treaty of peace between them.

THE KNOWLEDGE OF AUSPICIOUS AND INAUSPICIOUS MUHURTAS THROUGH NUMBERS: The sum of numbers of Tithi, day and Nakshtra should be put in three places and these should be divided respectively by 7, 8 and 3. If after dividing the remainder is zero in the First Place, then the person making the journey will get much grief in the journey; if the remainder is zero in the Second Place, then there will be loss of wealth (Money) to him; and if the remainder is zero in the Third Place,then there occurs the death of the person going on the journey. If after dividing the remainder is some number in all the three places, then the person going on the journey will get comfort and success.

25. THE DOSHAS (DEFECTS) OF MAHADALA AND BHRAMA : If after dividing by 7 the number which is arrived at from the Nakshtra in which the Sun is there to that in which the Moon is there, the remainder comes to be 2 and 7 (that is, zero), then there is the Dosha (Defect) named as ‘Mahadala’; and if the remainder comes to be 3 and 6, then there is the Dosha named ‘Bhrama’. Both these Doshas are to be avoided while making a journey.

26. THE YOGA (COMBINATION) NAMED HIMBER : To the number which is arrived at by counting from the Nakshtra in which the Sun is there to that in which there is the Moon is to be added the number which is arrived at by counting from the Pratipada Tithi of the Paksha (Shukla or Krishna) to the Tithi Number of the day on which the journey is to be made. If after dividing the Sum thus arrived at the remainder happens to be 7, then there is the Yoga named as Himber. This Yoga is excellent for making a journey.

27. THE GHAATA CHANDRA DOSHA : If the Moon of the persons whose Rashi be Aries (in whose horoscope the Moon is in Aries) be there in the First House (that is, the Moon be in Aries itself), of those whose Rashi is Taurus be there in the 5th House (that is the Moon be there in the Virgo Sign), of those whose Rashi is Gemini be there in the 9th House; of those whose Rashi is Cancer be there in the 2nd House; of those whose Rashi is Leo be there in the 6th House; of those whose Rashi be Virgo be there in the 10th House, of those whose Rashi is Libra be there in the 3rd House, of those whose Rashi is Scorpio be there in the 7th House, of those whose Rashi is Sagittarius be there in the 4th House, of those whose Rashi Capricorn be there in the 8th House, of those whose Rashi is Aquarius be there in the 11th House; and of those whose Rashi is Pisces be there in the 12th House; then there occurs the Dosha named 'Ghaata Chandra' (the Pain giving Moon). This 'Ghaata Chandra' should be avoided by a person when he goes to join a king's service (or government service), to make a quarrel, to fight a battle. It does not need to be avoided in other things.

28, 29. THE QUARTERS OF THE NAKSHTRAS WHICH SHOULD BE AVOIDED IN GHAATA CHANDRA : The natives having Aries as their Rashi (the sign in which the Moon is situated in the horoscope) should reject as inauspicious the first Quarter of the Kritika Nakshtra; those having Taurus, the second quarter of Magha; those having Gemini, the 3rd Quarter of Shatabhisha; those having Cancer, the 3rd Quarter of Magha; those having Leo, the Ist Quarter of Dhanishtha; those having Virgo, the 3rd Quarter of Ardra; those having Libra, the second Quarter of Moola; those having Scorpio, the 4th Quarter of Rohini; those having Sagittarius, the 3rd Quarter of Poorva bhadrapada; those having Capricorn the 4th Quarter of Magha; those having Aquarius, the 4th Quarter of Moola; and those having Pisces, the 3rd Quarter of Poorvabhadrapada.
